pack.name: schema-org-core
pack.description: Seed core vocabulary (ADR 081 decision 4): a curated schema.org Thing subset small models already emit, plus the Akh-native types (Akh, Goal, Skill, Decision). Property value types use Obsidian's set.

types.name: Thing
types.description: schema.org root: the most generic type of item.

types.name: Person
types.description: schema.org Person: a person (alive, dead, undead, or fictional).

types.name: Organization
types.description: schema.org Organization: a business, agency, NGO, club, etc.

types.name: Place
types.description: schema.org Place: entities with a somewhat fixed physical extension.

types.name: Event
types.description: schema.org Event: something happening at a time and location.

types.name: CreativeWork
types.description: schema.org CreativeWork: the most generic kind of creative work (documents, notes, code).

types.name: Akh
types.description: Akh-native: a workspace-unit lifeform (model + KG + notes + capabilities + behaviour).

types.name: Goal
types.description: Akh-native: a goal the agent pursues.

types.name: Decision
types.description: Akh-native: a recorded decision with rationale (ADR-shaped).

relations.name: worksFor
relations.description: schema.org worksFor: a person works for an organization.

relations.name: memberOf
relations.description: schema.org memberOf: an entity belongs to an organization.

relations.name: attendee
relations.description: schema.org attendee (inverted domain): an event has a person attending.

relations.name: authorOf
relations.description: Inverse-style authorship: a person authored a creative work.

relations.name: pursues
relations.description: Akh-native: an akh pursues a goal.
